event.title: Introduce streaming market recorder integrity audit
event.summary: Recorded exchange and receive timestamps, stale/interrupted data quality, crossed books, clock skew and repeated disconnects are analyzed separately from trading P&L. All code and synthetic fixtures remain inside Analytics.

changes.summary: Streaming market recorder integrity scanner with conservative quality metrics.
Four synthetic tests for malformed book, clock, gap and corrupt-tail handling.
Integrate tape quality pass into the read-only full analysis.
Explain recorder format and limits to interpreting sparse unchanged-book data.
